title: cancels every request the page has with the engine at once, as its own cancel cancels each

title: holds the cancel of every request for one the guard is still thinking about
why: A request the guard is still thinking about passed over: it is sent to the engine a moment after the window that asked for it was closed, and nothing stops it.
